title: 完成标准先约定再执行
premise: 回顾确认第一切片结果，下一轮优先补额外异常测试，再考虑周报与部署。
listeningTask: 识别改进责任、下轮优先级和发布仍需的审批。

lines.en: Let's refine our definition of done together. Evidence links should be ready before review.
lines.zh: 共同完善完成标准，评审前准备好证据链接。

lines.en: Include consumer sign-off and rollback rehearsal. Keep implementation completion separate from production deployment.
lines.zh: 包含使用方验收和回退预演，实现完成与生产部署分开。

lines.en: The carry over tests get priority next sprint. Maybe we'll postpone the second report slice.
lines.zh: 转下轮的测试优先，第二个报表切片可能延后。

lines.en: Every characterization test needs approved expected behavior. The consumer owner confirms unusual cases, right?
lines.zh: 每个行为测试需批准预期，使用方负责人确认特殊用例，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, and known defects stay labelled. Fixing one requires explicit updated acceptance criteria.
lines.zh: 是，已知缺陷保留标注，修复需明确更新验收标准。

lines.en: Okay, sample ownership is our first action item. Anika will obtain examples before sprint planning.
lines.zh: 好，样本负责人是第一项任务，Anika计划会前拿例子。

lines.en: I'll review the release proposal after testing. Scope changes need approval, not retrospective justification.
lines.zh: 测试后审发布申请，改范围需审批，不能事后找理由。

lines.en: I'll close the loop on boundary tests. The optional export request remains outside this plan.
lines.zh: 我把边界测试闭环，可选导出仍不在本计划。

lines.en: We'll inspect waiting time at next retro. One iteration won't establish a lasting trend.
lines.zh: 下次回顾看等待时长，一个迭代不能确立长期趋势。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll share today's decisions with consumers. They know what changed and what didn't.
lines.zh: 同意，分享今天决定，让使用方知道改变与未改变的部分。

scene: 回顾确认第一切片结果，下一轮优先补额外异常测试，再考虑周报与部署。
